rationale: This round's blocker fix, and the last round that touched the code owns the nomination. On the codex route the bridge fills a schema whose mutationClaim rides in as type ['object','null'], so a fabricated object is schema-valid and, being preferred over the committed artifact at the gate, would shadow the real nomination. forgeAgent now discards it in code rather than by instruction. Restoring the bare `return res` reopens exactly that hole: the two adversarial-bridge cases (build round and fix round) go red (verified 9 pass / 2 fail mutated, 11 pass / 0 fail restored) while the prover suite, which never runs the workflow body, stays green.
